verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card for AI vendor spend. Expense platforms of this kind could plausibly offer background automations such as spend rules or auto-categorization, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack describes user-configurable automations or autonomous background jobs: the docs cover rewards, partner perks, card requests and withdrawals, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404s.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
